notes: Op. 9, Op. 4, Op. 7, Op. 11 and Op. 12 entries were given set names that match the queued items. The queued double concertos use '2 violins & orchestra', but existing doubles use 'Orchestra (piano reduction)'; harmonise these on import. Queued facts were not audited line by line. A spot-check of the opus and RV numbers for Opp. 1, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9, 11 and 12 found no errors. RV 188 (Op. 7 No. 2), RV 326 (Op. 7 No. 3), RV 300 (Op. 9 No. 10) and RV 244/RV 173 (Op. 12 Nos. 2/4) could have their opus numbers added. The Grosso Mogul (384) at L8 looks a level high relative to RV 212 and Il favorito, but this is not flagged.
